name: Gyroscope Ethereum bridge incident
summary: CertiK reports a cross-chain callback accepted caller-selected execution that created unauthorized GYD approvals on Ethereum. It reports roughly USD 807,000 extracted; token face value and realized liquidity differ.

primary_sources.summary: Researcher analysis with source-reported bridge and Ethereum transaction references.

coverage_gaps: The incident spans Arbitrum and Ethereum; only the source-reported Ethereum transaction references are recorded here.
The report labels a Gyroscope address without fully establishing its historical deployment role; treat it as a candidate affected contract until source and proxy history are checked.
Chain, language, identifiers, historical implementation and economic impact are source-reported, not independently verified by Hindsight.
Source rights, earliest disclosure, exploit-family boundaries and human adjudication remain unresolved. No training or benchmark eligibility is established.
